verdict.rationale: Published board power, connector requirements and cooling guidance are a fair question for any GPU product, including a datacenter OAM accelerator, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only covers architecture, VRAM, compute units and an 8-GPU OAM system configuration. It contains no TDP/TGP figure, power-connector requirement or cooling guidance for the MI325X, and the vendor product page was unreachable.

support.subject: As a gamer, I can spec a build around published board power — TDP/TGP, connector requirements, and cooling guidance for this exact card
